title: A vasfüggöny lebontása és a határnyitás (Dismantling the Iron Curtain & Border Opening)
grammar: Constitutional Proclamations, Negotiated Democracy & Sovereign Historical Registers

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain what happened on the Austrian border in spring and summer 1989.
I can say what the Pan-European Picnic was and when the border was opened for East Germans.
I can use the words for the border: szögesdrót, vasfüggöny, határnyitás.
I can use the past tense to say what the refugees and the border guards did.
